result.description: Twilio SendGrid: cloud email delivery API for transactional and marketing email, with templates, contacts, stats and webhooks.
result.auth_detail: Scoped API key sent as Authorization: Bearer header. Keys are created per account in the SendGrid UI or via the API Keys endpoints. No OAuth2 for third-party developers (Basic auth with username 'apikey' is only mentioned in search snippets, not confirmed on the fetched page).
result.access_detail: Free signup with no card gets a 60-day trial limited to 100 emails/day. After that a paid plan is needed (Essentials from $19.95/mo). The older permanent free tier has been replaced. Users bring their own API key, so connecting users works once their account is active.
result.api_notes: v3 Web API covers mail send, templates, contacts and lists, marketing campaigns and singlesends, suppressions, stats, API keys, subusers, domain/sender authentication, webhooks and more. Some endpoints need specific scopes or higher plans (for example subusers).

evidence.quote: To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>` in your request.
Free trial lets you send 100 emails/day for 60 days
Essentials plan starts at $19.95 per month
The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
deyikong/sendgrid-mcp: community server with 58 tools. No official Twilio MCP server found in search results (Merge page says none offered).
